title: The Pink Santa Christmas Cookie Baking Day
description: A pink Christmas cookie baking day, all from Walmart: the Beautiful 5.3 qt stand mixer in Rose, the pink Holiday Time Santa cookie jar, footed Santa bowl and Santa tray, and Ann Clark Christmas cookie cutters.
intro: Cookie day is the one day a year the whole kitchen gets covered in flour and nobody is allowed to complain. This is the pink version. A Rose stand mixer with that little red knob, a Santa cookie jar that looks like he's mid-nap, a footed Santa bowl for the frosting, a Santa tray for the finished batch and three Ann Clark cutters, because the gingerbread man is not optional. Put on the music. Eat the broken ones. That's the rule.

sections.heading: The big piece
paragraphs: The Beautiful 5.3 qt tilt-head stand mixer by Drew Barrymore in Rose and Tomato Red, with the flat beater, dough hook and balloon whisk.

sections.heading: The pink Santa pieces
paragraphs: The Holiday Time Santa cookie jar in pink, the Holiday Time stoneware footed Santa bowl in pink and the Holiday Time Santa tray in pink, 13.6 by 14.1 inches.

sections.heading: The cutters
paragraphs: The Ann Clark Christmas cookie cutters 3-piece set: gingerbread man, tree and snowflake, made in the USA.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the cookies, the flour and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
